name: CtrlOps
tagline: CtrlOps is a local-first desktop app for managing all your Linux servers from one screen — no DevOps expertise required
description: CtrlOps is a local-first desktop app for managing all your Linux servers from one screen — no DevOps expertise required. **AI Terminal** — Describe your server issue in plain English. CtrlOps generates the exact command and waits for your approval before running anything. **Multi-Server Dashboard** — Connect every server in one place. No more spreadsheets of IPs and commands nobody remembers. **One-Click Deployments** — Deploy from any GitHub repo in under 5 minutes. No manual steps. No engineer
